# aphrody_browser crate

> Complete Chromium //ui/views browser in GPUI fused with ayvpn per-tab WireGuard/Mullvad routing, anomalyco/browse real-browser MCP relay, Kitesurf/Servo/Blink…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_browser/

Complete Chromium //ui/views browser in GPUI fused with ayvpn per-tab WireGuard/Mullvad routing, anomalyco/browse real-browser MCP relay, Kitesurf/Servo/Blink escalation, and the Full WebGPU OS (ai-os + cloudflare-os + nysh).
